snippet.title: Basement to the Sky - Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Basement to the Sky is a nostalgic rocket-crafting life simulation that takes you back to the golden days of childhood. Step into the shoes of your younger self: build and launch rockets, earn money by helping with chores, and cook your own delicious meals. Experiment with various parts to soar higher than ever before. Can your rocket truly reach the vastness of outer space? Embark on a journey where a child's dream meets the stars.
